title: What is known about 1RB0RB_1LC1RA_1LF0LD_0LE1LD_1RA1LC_---1LA
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0RB_1LC1RA_1LF0LD_0LE1LD_1RA1LC_---1LA.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open. Lean proves that, read in pairs, the tape at each turn is a binary word and one round trip of the head is one XOR sweep of it: find the rightmost 00, flip the letter left of it, replace every letter right of it by the XOR of itself and its right neighbour, append 11 (mstep_ok). A halt needs a 00 only at the very left end. The block of 111110 words enters the sweep only through its length mod 3 (zone_step), so Lean drops it: the machine halts from blank tape iff the zone orbit halts (halts_iff_zone), and compiled evaluation runs that orbit through the first 1.7·1015 steps without a halt. Since the last arrival the tape holds a new zone, a stranded block of 8,397 letters and the old zone at the left end. By the Lean lemmas the old zone moves only when a sweep gets through the new zone, and for as long as the block lasts it then moves exactly as it would alone: run alone it has no reset and no halt in the 8,397 ticks the block covers. In 3·1010 sweeps from zone step 3·107 only 23 sweeps got through (about 7 per factor of 10).

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (F0); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: The halting pattern
claims.text: 0 0 1 D> 0, the pass on the separator right of a block of length 1 with two 0s on its left, halts three steps later (F reads 0). By the table this is the only way to halt after the first step (hand argument in the README).

claims.title: The pass
claims.text: Moving left from separator to separator, the pass cuts a block of length k+3 into k+1 and 1 and goes on (pass_split); a block of length 1 stops it (pass_stop). For all lengths and every surrounding tape.

claims.title: Crossing the block of words does not depend on its length
claims.text: The pass crosses n words 111110 in 6n steps, in the same state, turning each into 1110 10; the sweep back turns them into 111110 again. For every n and every surrounding tape.

claims.title: The pass machine
claims.text: A turn configuration RT out rest (C on a pair 11, the pairs out to its left, the cells rest to its right). One macro step mstep: a left pass over the pairs (scanF: skip 11; after a 01, a 11 becomes 01 and the pass goes on, a 01 becomes 11 and the head turns), the three ways of running off the left end (E0 = 1RA adds a pair 01 with a blank first cell), and a right pass over the cells (apass: a1 → (¬a)1, 10 bounces, 00 ends). mstep_sound: for all lists, the machine goes from RT out rest to the configuration mstep names in exactly the steps it names, or halts there.

claims.title: Halting is exactly a question about the orbit
claims.text: orbT k: the k-th turn configuration from blank tape with its step count (orbT_sound). halts_iff: the machine halts from blank tape if and only if some macro step of the orbit halts.

claims.title: No halt in the first 4·10<sup>8</sup> steps
claims.text: The first 20,000 macro steps of the orbit, evaluated by compiled code: no halt, more than 4·10<sup>8</sup> machine steps (through the first six resets of the left end).

claims.title: One round trip is one XOR sweep
claims.text: At a turn at the right end, read in pairs, the tape is a binary word. When it has a 00, one macro step is exactly one sweep: the rightmost 00 is found, the letter left of it is flipped, every letter right of it becomes the XOR of itself and its right neighbour, and 11 is appended (4d + 12 steps, d the depth of the 00). A 00 only at the very left end halts; no 00 at all is a reset at the left end.

claims.title: The leftmost-zone reduction
claims.text: For every length of the block of words the sweep does the same thing to the rest of the word; the length enters only mod 3, through one letter (zone_step). A sweep that finds its 00 early leaves everything further left untouched (swr_append_ok), and a sweep through a stretch without 00 acts beyond it only through the stretch’s last letter (swr_split).
claims.where: lean/Xor.lean (the same file for the four machines with this block)

claims.title: Halting is a question about the zone orbit
claims.text: The zone orbit keeps only the count of the block of words and the rest of the word; it uses the sweep at the right end and the pass machine at the left end. The machine halts from blank tape if and only if the zone orbit halts.

claims.title: No halt in the first 1.7·10<sup>15</sup> steps
claims.text: 3·10<sup>7</sup> steps of the zone orbit, evaluated by compiled code, without a halt; they cover more than 1.7·10<sup>15</sup> machine steps.

claims.title: No halt in 10<sup>11</sup> steps; the arrivals at the left end
claims.text: The real machine runs 10<sup>11</sup> steps without a halt. Passes reached the left end of the tape at triggers 1, 4, 7, 12, 18, 24, 45, 2384 and 8520 (step 143,858,957). At the last one the zone started again at the right end and a block of about 2,820 words stayed behind.

claims.title: The reduced system
claims.text: With the growing block cut to 10 words at every trigger (cutting whole words keeps the length mod 3, so by zone_step the cut is exact between arrivals at the left end), the run from trigger 20,000 to 1,073,741,824 has no halt and no arrival at the left end; the deepest pass came within 65 cells of it.

claims.title: The leftmost zone alone
claims.text: The leftmost zone run by itself, one arriving pass at a time, from the real configuration of trigger 100, reproduces the real arrival of trigger 8520 (same new cells, same blocks afterwards). Continued, this model halts in its tick 4,581,101 after 19 more arrivals. That is not a prediction for the machine: after trigger 8520 the old zone gets a pass only when the new zone lets one through (32 of them by trigger 5,165,364, fewer than 64 by trigger 3·10<sup>8</sup>; the model needs about 4.6 million), and the block between the two zones is being used up, which the model does not describe.

claims.title: Halting needs the left end
claims.text: Every halt of the macro step happens at the left end of the word: a sweep halts exactly when the only 00 of the word is at its very left end, and the other halting cases of the pass machine are passes that run off the left end.

claims.title: Two zones
claims.text: Since the last arrival the tape holds a new zone, a stranded block of 8,397 letters and the old zone at the left end. By the Lean lemmas the old zone moves only when a sweep gets through the new zone, and for as long as the block lasts it then moves exactly as it would alone: run alone it has no reset and no halt in the 8,397 ticks the block covers. In 3·10<sup>10</sup> sweeps from zone step 3·10<sup>7</sup> only 23 sweeps got through (about 7 per factor of 10). The old zone moving as if alone while the block lasts is a hand argument from the Lean lemmas (the cells that can differ spread from the new zone by at most one per sweep that reaches the block), checked against the zone orbit at all 23 passes of a run of 3·10<sup>10</sup> sweeps.
claims.where: c/xs.c, c/z1.c in the folder of 1RB0RB_1LC1RA_1LF0LD_0LE1LD_1LA1LC_---1LA, from the state written by lean/DumpState.lean; README.md

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Not known. It halts if a pass reaches the leftmost block while that block is a lone 1 with blank tape on its left; nothing known forces or forbids that.

claims.title: Related holdouts
claims.text: The same table as 1RB1LD_1RC0RC_1LD1RB_1LF0LE_0LA1LE_---1LB up to renaming, started in another state; no common configuration in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps of each.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows. A zone of about a hundred cells is rewritten again and again by passes coming from the right, where a block of 111110 words keeps growing. The machine stops only if a pass gets through the whole zone and finds a lone 1 at the very left end of the tape. The last pass to get there did so at step 143,858,957 and did not stop the machine.

facts.text: The halting pattern: a pass meets a block of length 1 with two 0s on its left.
Crossing the block of words is proved not to depend on its length.
No halt, by compiled evaluation of the zone orbit (Lean).

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.605).
After 109 steps the tape spans 58,407 cells (19 left of the start, 45,037 right), with a density of 1s of 0.733.

sections.heading: A counter beside a growing block
html: The tape is a row of blocks of 1s with single 0s between them. At the right end a block of words 111110 grows by two cells per round trip of the head. Left of it is a zone of about a hundred cells that every round trip rewrites.

A round trip starts at the right end. The pass runs left in state D: it crosses the words (each becomes 1110 10), and in the zone it cuts every block of three or more 1s into two, until it meets a block of length 1, where it stops. The head then sweeps back, restoring the words. How deep the passes get behaves like a counter: deeper passes are rarer and rarer.

The machine halts only on 0 0 1 D> 0: the pass finds a block of length 1 with two 0s on its left. Inside the tape the 0s are single (observed), so this needs a pass that gets through the whole zone and finds a lone 1 at the very left end of the tape.

Passes reached the left end at triggers 1, 4, 7, 12, 18, 24, 45, 2384 and 8520 (a trigger is a new cell on the right in state B). At the last one, step 143,858,957, the zone started again at the right end; the block of about 2,820 words it had built stayed behind, between the new zone and the old one. The old zone now moves only when the new one overflows.

Cutting the growing block short should not change the rest of the tape, because Lean proves that crossing it does not depend on its length. That reduction is checked on 20,000 triggers but not proved. The reduced run, followed to trigger 1,073,741,824, has no halt and no new arrival at the left end.

sections.heading: One round trip is one XOR sweep
html: Read two cells at a time (11 is the letter 1, 01 the letter 0), the tape at each turn at the right end is a binary word. Lean proves that one round trip of the head does exactly this to it (mstep_ok):

1. find the rightmost 00;
  2. flip the letter just left of it;
  3. replace every letter right of it by the XOR of itself and its right neighbour;
  4. append 11.

If the only 00 is at the very left end, the machine halts. So a halt needs a pass that gets all the way to the left end of the tape. The block of 111110 words is the stretch …011011 at the right end. XOR differences turn it into itself shifted, so its length does not matter, except mod 3 (zone_step). Lean drops the block and keeps only its length: the machine halts if and only if this smaller system, the zone orbit, halts (halts_iff_zone). Compiled evaluation runs the zone orbit through the first 1.7·1015 steps without a halt.

Since the last arrival the tape holds a new zone, a stranded block of 8,397 letters and the old zone at the left end. By the Lean lemmas the old zone moves only when a sweep gets through the new zone, and for as long as the block lasts it then moves exactly as it would alone: run alone it has no reset and no halt in the 8,397 ticks the block covers. In 3·1010 sweeps from zone step 3·107 only 23 sweeps got through (about 7 per factor of 10).

sections.heading: An exact reduction in Lean
sections.html:
The reduced system above is a model. A second, independent analysis reads the tape two cells at a time: the pair 11 is a letter 1 and the pair 01 a letter 0, so the tape is a binary word. Lean defines one macro step of the machine on such words (one sweep to the right end and back, including the rare resets at the left end) and proves, for every word, that the machine really does what the macro step says (mstep_sound, lean/Sweep.lean).

From this, halts_iff in lean/Reduce.lean states: the machine halts from blank tape if and only if some macro step of the orbit from the blank tape halts. So the question is now purely about this word map, with no tape left in it. Lean's compiled check (native_decide) runs the macro orbit far enough to cover the first 4·108 machine steps without a halt (blank_runs_orbit, lean/OrbitRun.lean). Whether the orbit ever halts is still open.

sections.heading: Related machines
html: Other holdouts of the list of 608 that are tied to this one. The comparison of tables is exact; everything about runs was checked on the first 107 steps of each machine and is an observation, not a proof (holdouts/related.py, holdouts/related.json).

Same table as the machine below, started in another state. Renaming the states as shown turns this machine's table into the other one, the halting transition included. The other machine starts in its own state A, which is not this machine's A: its run from blank tape is the run of this table started in another state. These are different runs: in the first 107 steps of each, no configuration of this machine's run occurs in the other, even up to a shift of the tape. So each of these holdouts is its own halting question, and settling one does not settle another.

family: Counter zone beside a growing block of 111110 words; a halt needs a lone 1 at the left end of the tape
summary: A zone of about a hundred cells is rewritten like a counter by passes coming from a growing block of 111110 words; a halt needs a pass that reaches a lone 1 at the left end of the tape. The last arrival at the left end was at step 143,858,957; no halt in 10^11 steps.
